purpose: Gives the main tag of a record, or of a page of records, read from the platform in one call per record and one call per fifty records, kept in one shared cache that a tag change refreshes at once.
namedChanges: the imports at the top of `src/mainTag.ts` are new: `useMemo` from `react`; `useQuery`, `useQueries` and the type `QueryClient` from `@tanstack/react-query`; `readMainTags`, `MASTERS_BATCH_MAX` and the type `MainTagRead` from the peer `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-tag-client`; the type `PlatformClient` from the peer `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-record-sync`; `platformFetch` from the peer `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-platform-fetch`; `boundAwait` from the peer `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-lws-relations` (its `boundAwait` is the app's, comments apart); `vaultOriginOf` from the peer `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-vault-origin-rule`; `needsMainTag` from `./needsMainTag` (the source imports them from `gilb-stakeholders` and from the app's `./boundAwait`, `./config`, `./entityDisplayName` and `./stakeholderCard`);

in `src/needsMainTag.ts`, `PARTY_NAME_FLOOR.name` is written as its literal value `"name"` (with a comment saying so), and `CANONICAL_DISPLAY_SLUG` and `MASTER_TAG_SLUGS` (lines 22 and 28 of `entityDisplayName.ts`) are private constants of that file, with the same values, the word `export` taken off: this unit cannot import `record-cache-kit`, which will import this unit;
the doc comment of `vaultOfEntity` named a real host as its example; it names `https://ann.example.test/base`;
comments: the cycle and ticket tags (`C214 TA2`) are removed from the doc comment of `needsMainTag`, and the two file headers are new, shorter ones; no code changed.
